package rulefixtures

// scenario for map_of_slices_prealloc: `m[k] = append(m[k], v)` in loops without pre-allocating inner slices
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func scenario617Positive(items []string) map[byte][]string {
	m := make(map[byte][]string)
	for _, item := range items {
		k := item[0]
		m[k] = append(m[k], item)
	}
	return m
}
